context: Hina-young learns to write a calligraphy character; Sachiko-grandma teaches.
purpose: Grandmother sharing brush-art craft with teen.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Gentle instruction, not correction. Her voice settles into the teaching posture of someone who has shown this a hundred times. Patient pause before the key word.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright but controlled — eager to get it right, not showboating. Small voice, listening for approval. The careful concentration of a child trying to do something that matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Quiet, meditative. Each phrase distinct and unhurried. Not commanding — offering wisdom. The tone of someone who knows that calligraphy teaches itself if you listen.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Calligraphy stills the heart, doesn't it.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself but meant for Hina to hear. Gentle realization dawning. The small joy of a child understanding something deeper than the brushstrokes.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: You've written such a beautiful character.
lines.style: Warm, deliberate pride in her voice. The words land solid. Not over-praised — honest recognition of something genuinely well done. A moment held between them.
